reason: In queue_consumer.py, join(self, timeout=None) at lines ~344-345 simply calls self.close() and never uses timeout. close() joins the commit thread with timeout=5.0, then FixedQueuePool.shutdown() joins each worker in turn with timeout=5.0 (lines ~242-243), so a call that arroyo makes after close() can block about 5s plus 5s per busy worker, past the deadline arroyo passed in.
